'''Raz and the Ubo-Kings''' was a musical band active during the periods of [[Galactic War]], [[Eternal Empire conquest]] and [[War against Zakuul|Revolt against the Eternal Empire]].

==History==
The band was founder and led by a short-tempered [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Raz (Duros)|Raz]] and spend years in obscurity on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Raz claimed that their talents were wasted there and their music was way ahead of the time.<ref name="SWTOR" />

In [[3636 BBY]] the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] led to much of the galaxy being dominated by the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. Through unknown means, holos of the band's performances were brought to Zakuul, where they became an overnight sensation, played not just on on street corners and in underground dance venues, but in every club on the [[Spire (Zakuul)|Spire]] - the Eternal Empire's capital [[City/Legends|city]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

Meanwhile, Raz and the Ubo-kings were stuck on Nar Shaddaa, unable to profit from their explosive success on Zakuul. Raz eventually was able to prep a tour to the Spire, but by that time then-current Emperor [[Arcann]] was dethroned and his [[Eternal Throne]] was assumed by his sister [[Vaylin]], who banned offworld music on Zakuul.<ref name="SWTOR" /> Vaylin was soon replaced by [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and [[Indo Zal]] arranged for Raz and the Ubo-kings to play at the related festivities.<ref name="Indo">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref> Their expenses costed Zal more than that of a small [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="Coronation">{{TORcite|type=message|A Coronation for the Ages!|Indo Zal}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Raz and the Ubo-Kings are mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' in a Codex entry obtained during '''"Chapter VI: The Dragon's Maw"'''.
